items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Do you remember old man Cottrell, Louis Cottrell's father

ctx.x: Teo, Leo Teo. No, I never played with him. Teo, what I was trying to tell you about, that was the fellow for Warline. He used to have Mr. Fred Tudry. He used to run the piano store for Warline. Yeah, I'm not sure. Fred Tudry and them. Yeah, that was relation to the Carreras. Dr. Tudry and them. All that's relation. Gladys Carreras and all them.

Do you remember old man Cottrell, Louis Cottrell's father, the guitar player who was the, I think he worked for Warline's too. Yeah. And picking out drums for him and things sometimes, at least test them out for him. Do you remember how he played? Anything about him much on the street or how? It was pretty good.
Well, you were good. One of the best actors. Yeah, you. How are you?
